## Use Case

Describe the application need and who benefits.

## Proposed Contract

Describe the desired behavior, inputs, outputs, lifecycle, and alternatives.
Identify what belongs in the library and what a supplied object should handle.

## Privacy, Security, And Compatibility

Describe new authority, metadata, trust assumptions, dependencies, wire changes,
or recovery consequences. Explain the effect on existing consumers.

## Acceptance Criteria

Describe observable behavior and how it could be verified with synthetic data.
Use SECURITY.md for undisclosed vulnerability details.
